pentecost-church-begins.description: A painted dim interior with rough timber beams and a stone or plaster wall. About a dozen bearded men and veiled women in robes of red, maroon, navy, ochre and grey crowd together, all gazing upward. Small flames flicker on the walls and near a few heads, and a shaft of light falls from the upper left. An arched doorway sits in the background. The style is a dark, oil-painted realism with no visible text, frame or signature.

mani-founds-manichaeism.description: A bearded, long-haired man in white robes kneels on a patterned rug at night, palms raised, facing a glowing translucent kneeling figure that mirrors his pose. The setting is a brick courtyard with arched, carved and tiled walls under a starry sky. Books, scrolls, a brass ewer and a lamp lie around. No letters, frame, border or graphic content.

anan-founds-karaite-judaism.description: A bearded man in a turban and dark, layered robes sits at a desk in a dim, arched library. He gestures toward a tall stack of leather-bound books on the left, and a partly unrolled scroll lies on the table in front of him. A lit oil lamp glows on the right, with shelves of books behind. No visible text, frame or border.

druze-faith-emerges.description: An arcaded courtyard at dusk with crenellated walls and two minarets behind. A robed, bearded man in a turban stands on the right with one arm raised, addressing a group of turbaned men seated on rugs around lamplight. A second standing man in a dark robe holds a sheet of paper. Lanterns and an oil lamp light the stone floor. Painterly, warm and dark tones, no visible text, no frame.

bruno-founds-carthusians.description: Several hooded monks in pale, rough habits work in a snowy pine forest on a steep slope. One carries a long timber on his shoulder, one saws at a small wooden hut with a stone base and a plank roof, and a central monk lifts a large stone while others stack stones into a dry wall. Snow falls under a dark, light-streaked sky.

cistercians-founded-citeaux.description: Five monks in grey-white habits and dark scapulars work in a marshy, reed-filled wetland under a stormy sky. One in the foreground cuts reeds with a scythe-like tool, another carries a long timber, and others carry bundles of cut reed or raise a post. Behind them is a half-built timber-framed roof structure among bare trees. The painting fills the frame with no visible text, border or wall.

knights-templar-founded.description: Inside a vaulted stone chapel with candles and a crucifix on a side altar, five mail-clad knights in white mantles kneel in prayer. The central knight has his hands clasped, and swords lie on the flagstone floor in front of them. The scene is painted in warm, dark oil tones.

peter-waldo-waldensians.description: A bearded man in a dark blue robe with a belt stands in a crowded medieval street of half-timbered houses, handing coins from his hand to a huddled woman in a shawl and a crowd of ragged people. An open wooden chest at his feet spills gold coins onto the cobbles, and a small child with bare feet reaches up. A stone church tower with a spire rises in the hazy background. A small green mark sits in the bottom-right corner.

dominic-founds-dominicans.description: A man in a white habit and black cloak stands on a stone step, one hand raised and the other holding an open book, speaking to a crowd. Several hooded friars in black and white stand behind him at left. The setting is a medieval town square with stone arches and half-timbered buildings, with market stalls and a crowd of townspeople in plain wool clothing. The painting fills the frame edge to edge, with no visible text or border.

smyth-founds-first-baptists.description: A bearded man in black 17th-century clothing with a white falling collar kneels beside a stone basin of water in a dim brick room, one hand raised. Around him a small group sits and kneels: a man on the left with hands clasped, two women in white coifs and dark dresses on the right, and more figures in the background by a doorway. A hearth with a hanging cauldron is at the left. The style is an oil painting, with no visible text, frame or border.
